messages.content: Aron spends 30 minutes/day three times a week vacuuming and 20 minutes/day 2 days a week dusting. How much time does he spend cleaning total each week?

First, I calculate the time Aron spends vacuuming each week. He spends 30 minutes/day, three times a week, so:
30 minutes/day * 3 days/week = 90 minutes/week

Next, I calculate the time he spends dusting each week. He spends 20 minutes/day, two days a week, so:
20 minutes/day * 2 days/week = 40 minutes/week

To find the total time spent cleaning each week, I add the time spent vacuuming and dusting:
90 minutes/week + 40 minutes/week = 130 minutes/week

So, Aron spends 130 minutes cleaning each week.

FINAL: 130

\[ 90 \text{ minutes/week} + 40 \text{ minutes/week} = 130 \text{ minutes/week} \]
